hero.title: Literature Monitor
hero.compactDescription: PubMed, Europe PMC, medRxiv, arXiv & WeChat signals
hero.description: Monitor recent biomedical papers, preprints, WeChat articles, and research notes from PubMed, Europe PMC, medRxiv, arXiv, WeChat 公众号, and Xiaohongshu, then review them as a screening list organized by topic match, recency, source signal, and abstract quality.
hero.selectProjectHint: Select a project in the sidebar first, then send papers into chat for analysis intake.

steps: Click "Settings" to configure your research domains and keywords
Add arXiv categories that match your biomedical preprint interests
Adjust "Results to show" and "Max results to scan" as needed
Click "Start Search" to fetch the latest papers
Click "Settings" to define disease, cohort, or methods keywords
Adjust the lookback window and scan size for your monitoring cadence

Adjust the lookback window and scan size for your monitoring cadence
medRxiv will fetch recent preprints and rank them automatically

WeChat 公众号 articles are fetched through RSSHub; the public instance works for a quick trial
Paste WeChat account routes in Settings, one per line, such as wechat/ce/huxiu_com
If the public RSSHub instance is rate-limited, point the instance URL at your own RSSHub
Optionally add research domains to filter articles by your interests
Click "Start Search" to fetch the latest articles
wechat.note: Public rsshub.app instances may be rate-limited. For reliable use, run RSSHub yourself: docker run -d -p 1200:1200 diygod/rsshub

steps: Use QR login or browser-cookie login first so Xiaohongshu searches can authenticate correctly
Configure search keywords for paper notes, methods summaries, or research commentary
Research domain keywords still drive relevance scoring, but Xiaohongshu posts are treated as research signals rather than formal papers
Click "Start Search" to fetch the latest posts
xiaohongshu.note: If xiaohongshu-cli is not installed, run this on the computer hosting MedHelp Local Engine: uv tool install xiaohongshu-cli

settings.tokenHelp: Stored securely in your account's credential store. Leave blank to keep any saved key unchanged.
settings.tokenSavedPlaceholder: Key already saved; paste to replace
settings.tokenPendingClear: Will be removed from the credential store when you save.
settings.wechatRsshubDescription: WeChat 公众号 articles are fetched through RSSHub. The public instance is fine for light use; self-host for reliability.
settings.wechatInstanceHelp: Default: https://rsshub.app. Point this at your own RSSHub if the public instance is rate-limited.
settings.wechatAccessKeyPlaceholder: Optional access key for private RSSHub instances
settings.wechatAccountsHelp: One route per line. Use a relative RSSHub path (wechat/ce/<id>), a full URL, or just the bare ID (auto-prefixed with wechat/ce/).
settings.wechatAccountsFormat: Tip: the most stable route is wechat/ce/<id> (chuansongme proxy). See docs.rsshub.app for more.
settings.browserCookieDescription: Read browser cookies from the computer running MedHelp Local Engine. Make sure a browser on that computer is already logged into xiaohongshu.com.
settings.serviceMachineHint: Xiaohongshu runs through the Local Engine. Cookies are read from that computer, not the web server or another device displaying this page. Prefer QR login for remote use.
settings.cookieSourceDescription: If auto-detection fails, choose the browser installed on the Local Engine computer.
settings.cookieFailure: Login failed. Make sure a browser on the Local Engine computer is logged into xiaohongshu.com.
settings.qrLoginDescription: Prefer this mode for remote deployments or Linux environments where browser-cookie extraction is less reliable.
settings.qrFailure: QR login failed. Please try again.
settings.qrRecommendedHint: This looks like a remote-access setup, so QR login is recommended by default because it does not depend on reading browser cookies from the host machine.
settings.searchKeywordsPlaceholder: medical paper, clinical research, medical AI, bioinformatics...
settings.maxEuropepmcResults: Max Europe PMC results to scan
